| | png_create_read_struct with the default allocator, png_read_info, png_read_image, png_destroy_read_struct | baseline: no user malloc_fn or free_fn and no mem_ptr; assert a clean allocation and free balance across the whole read |
| | png_create_read_struct_2 with a counting user malloc_fn and free_fn, png_get_mem_ptr | assert every allocation during png_read_info, png_read_update_info, png_read_row and png_read_end goes through the user allocator — row_buf, prev_row, read_buffer, the palette, the gamma tables and the chunk list — and that mem_ptr is retrievable |
| | png_create_write_struct_2 with a user malloc_fn and free_fn | the same for the write path: row_buf, try_row, tst_row, prev_row, the zbuffer_list and png_text_compress's output buffers |
| | png_create_read_struct_2 / png_create_write_struct_2 with partial or degenerate allocators | malloc_fn non-NULL with free_fn NULL and the reverse (validated inside png_create_png_struct); and both NULL with a non-NULL mem_ptr |
| | png_create_read_struct_2 with a failing malloc_fn | failure on the very first allocation (returns NULL, no png_ptr); failure part-way through png_read_info (the png_error path, asserting no leak); and failure inside png_malloc_warn (returns NULL and only warns) |
| | png_set_mem_fn after struct creation | install a different allocator mid-life and assert subsequent allocations use it while earlier blocks are still freed correctly; also png_set_mem_fn(png_ptr, ptr, NULL, NULL) |
| | png_data_freer(PNG_DESTROY_WILL_FREE_DATA) then png_destroy_read_struct / png_destroy_info_struct | for each of PNG_FREE_PLTE, TRNS, HIST, ICCP, SPLT, ROWS, PCAL, SCAL, UNKN, TEXT, EXIF and PNG_FREE_ALL: set the corresponding data, call png_data_freer, and assert the data is released on destroy |
| | png_data_freer(PNG_SET_WILL_FREE_DATA) x each PNG_FREE_* bit; png_data_freer(PNG_USER_WILL_FREE_DATA) x each PNG_FREE_* bit | assert free_me is set so a subsequent png_set_* or png_free_data releases the old data; assert free_me is cleared, libpng does not free the data, and png_destroy_info_struct causes no double free |
| | png_data_freer with an invalid freer value | any value other than 1, 2 or 3: png_error("Unknown freer parameter in png_data_freer"); also png_ptr or info_ptr NULL |
| | png_free_data with num at or above 0 versus num == -1 | on a PNG_FREE_MUL bit (SPLT, TEXT, UNKN): a non-negative num frees only that element and leaves free_me intact while -1 frees all and clears the free_me bit; also num out of range, and a mask whose free_me bit was never set |
| | png_set_rows + png_data_freer(PNG_DESTROY_WILL_FREE_DATA, PNG_FREE_ROWS) + png_free_data | png_set_rows deliberately does not set free_me, so png_free_data(PNG_FREE_ROWS, -1) frees nothing until png_data_freer is used; also png_set_rows(NULL) clearing the rows and png_set_rows with the identical pointer, where the free is skipped |
